reason: All nine evaluated descriptions were rewritten to satisfy the open Agent Skills spec (capability clause plus trigger clause). Five of them were then revised again against the trigger family's first train run, which is the first measurement that observes the host actually loading a skill: zhanggui-requesting-code-review (recall 0.556), zhanggui-verification-before-completion (recall 0.833, precision 0.714 against finishing-a-development-branch), zhanggui-using-git-worktrees (recall 0.810), zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents (recall 0.857) and zhanggui-finishing-a-development-branch (wording only, to stop pulling verification-before-completion into landing-decision requests). The train split produced those failures; the validation split has not been used to choose any wording. status stays pending-reevaluation because the trigger family publishes run records, not the judge-harness summary shape that the measured branch of this gate pins.

changes_since_supersede.evidence: No failing routing case. This is spec alignment, not a regression fix.
changes_since_supersede.change: Prepended a capability clause to the existing "Use when" trigger clause. Every trigger keyword and precondition present in the superseded catalog was preserved verbatim.
preserved_preconditions: zhanggui-test-driven-development: "the failing test or regression test must be written first, before any implementation code exists"
zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents: "subagent capacity is available" and "non-overlapping files"

capability_clauses_added.zhanggui: Owns one development request end-to-end — resolves open design decisions, plans the path, implements with tests, and carries the work to verified delivery.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-systematic-debugging: Traces a failure to its root cause with evidence before any fix is written, then guards the finding with a regression test.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-test-driven-development: Drives implementation from a failing test — red first, then the minimum code to go green.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-verification-before-completion: Proves a completion claim with fresh evidence — real command output, test results, an actual run — before anyone acts on it.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-requesting-code-review: Runs a new independent review of a diff or code change and reports Critical and Important findings by severity.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-receiving-code-review: Verifies incoming review feedback item by item and gives each one an explicit disposition — accepted, rejected with evidence, or implemented.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-using-git-worktrees: Creates an isolated git worktree for feature work so the main working tree stays untouched, including setup and later cleanup.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents: Runs independent pieces of work at the same time instead of one after another, keeping one writer per file set.
capability_clauses_added.zhanggui-finishing-a-development-branch: Closes out verified branch or worktree work with one explicit decision — merge, open a pull request, keep the branch, or discard it.

changes_since_supersede.scope: five evaluated descriptions, revised against the first trigger-family train run
changes_since_supersede.evidence: evals/results/triggers-train-run1.json, host claude with the reference adapter, 93 train queries x 3 runs, 274 of 279 invocations scored. Baseline train pass rate 85/93 = 0.914. Only train failures were used; the validation split was not consulted to choose any wording.

per_skill.observed_failure: recall 0.556. "review 一下这个 diff，只审查不要改", "帮我审查这三个文件的改动" and "迁移脚本要上线了，先做一次代码审查" loaded nothing, while the queries that named an independent reviewer or a severity ranking did trigger.
per_skill.change: Rewrote the trigger clause around the plain ask — asking for a review, 审查, or 过一遍 of a diff, patch, or changed files — and dropped the "before verification, merge, delivery, or dependent work starts" gate that read as an unmet precondition.

per_skill.observed_failure: recall 0.833, precision 0.714. It missed "Before you say this is done, I want the actual command output, not a summary of it." and fired on six finishing-a-development-branch runs such as "测试过了，你决定下是合还是开 PR" and "这个功能做完了也验证过，我想收尾", where the evidence already existed and only the landing decision was open.
per_skill.change: Scoped the trigger to a completion claim being made or accepted without fresh evidence for it, added the ask for actual command output rather than a summary, and dropped "pull request" from the commit/push/handoff list so the landing-decision wording belongs to finishing-a-development-branch alone.

per_skill.observed_failure: No failure of its own (recall 1.000, precision 1.000); it was the target the six verification-before-completion false positives landed beside.
per_skill.change: Wording only. "has already passed verification" became "whose verification is already settled" so the shared word "verification" no longer advertises this skill in a way that also pulls in verification-before-completion.

per_skill.observed_failure: recall 0.810. "建完 worktree 后面还要清理掉，别留垃圾" loaded nothing in all three runs, because the trigger clause only covered work that still needs an isolated checkout.
per_skill.change: Capability clause now covers tearing a worktree down again, and the trigger clause adds the case where an existing worktree has to be set up or cleaned up rather than left behind.

per_skill.observed_failure: recall 0.857. "并行派发的时候注意别让两个 agent 改同一个文件" triggered once in three runs, because the trigger clause assumed the parallel dispatch still had to be decided.
per_skill.change: Trigger clause adds the case where the parallel dispatch is already decided and only the non-overlapping file scope remains to be settled.

changes_since_supersede.scope: two non-evaluated descriptions, revised against the same train run
changes_since_supersede.evidence: Same run. These skills are outside the nine-entry catalog snapshot (they are standalone skills, not root/leaf routing targets), so this entry is not digest-pinned; it is recorded here for completeness.

per_skill.observed_failure: precision 0.810. "这几个规则文件应该放哪" (a question about where rule files belong) loaded setup-collaboration-files in all three runs, and "帮我把 README 整理一下" once.
per_skill.change: Added the positive precondition that the initialization or normalization itself has to be carried through, which a question about file placement does not satisfy.
per_skill.measured_outcome: Half ineffective, and recorded rather than quietly dropped. nm-ip-01 went from 1/3 to 0/3, which is where the train precision move from 0.810 to 0.857 came from. nm-ip-02 did not move at all - 3/3 in the baseline train run, 3/3 in the revised train run, and still 3/3 in results/triggers-recheck-renamed-skill.json.

second_attempt.change: Rewrote the capability clause around writing the files instead of naming the file types as a topic, and replaced the precondition with 'Use when those files themselves are the deliverable'.
second_attempt.result: Zero movement. Arm A (shipped description) and arm B (candidate) were indistinguishable on the same three queries at five runs each - nm-ip-02 fired 5/5 in both, ip-pos-03 and ip-pos-05 fired 5/5 in both. Records in results/probe-setupfiles-arm-a.json and results/probe-setupfiles-arm-b.json.

per_skill.mechanism: From the captured transcript, the model loads this skill for nm-ip-02 with the argument '说明规则文件应放置的位置' - it reads the skill as the reference that documents the layout, answers the question from it, and edits nothing. Any description that names the file layout as this skill's subject makes the skill the reference for layout questions, which is why both phrasings fail identically.

corpus_change.what: nm-ip-02 was relabelled from a should-trigger-nothing query to a should-trigger query for setup-collaboration-files, and nm-dn-03 was promoted to a hard negative for the same skill to keep the declared-hard-negative floor at 6.
corpus_change.why: Wording was proven unable to move this query (two phrasings, five runs each, indistinguishable), and the label contradicted the skill itself - its target table is the answer to the question being labelled as should-not-trigger. That makes it an instrument defect rather than a description defect.
corpus_change.cost: None to comparability. No query id and no split moved, so split_sha256 stayed c980836bdcc1 and the four rate records above remain comparable with later full runs. The counter-argument (the skill runs its workflow without asking once loaded) is recorded in the corpus file itself under labelling_notes.
corpus_change.measured_after: results/triggers-recheck-renamed-skill.json - 14 queries x 3 runs, 39 successful, train 10/10, validation 4/4, recall 1.000, precision 0.968 (the single false positive is nm-ip-01 firing once in three runs, a pre-existing flake).

per_skill.observed_failure: precision 0.913. "记录一下今天的进度" loaded decision-notes in two of three runs.
per_skill.change: Narrowed the capability clause to the reasoning behind a choice between alternatives, so a request to log progress is not a decision note.

changes_since_supersede.evidence: No failing routing case prompted this. It was a design hypothesis: a root description claiming a full lifecycle reads as a generalist and steals the leaves' territory. That hypothesis was then measured and not supported.
changes_since_supersede.change: Attempted narrowing (preconditions only: unresolved design decisions, work outliving one session, saved checkpoint), measured, then reverted to the alias-free lifecycle wording that preceded it.
changes_since_supersede.outcome: reverted — hypothesis not supported by measurement

measured_outcome.measurement_condition: host claude (reference adapter, stream-json), driving model deepseek-flash via a private Anthropic-compatible gateway, concurrency 4, --timeout-ms 600000, split_sha256 c980836bdcc1

subset_ab.reading: One event of difference in root recall; nothing else moved. An earlier 1-run version of this same experiment reported 0.600 vs 0.400 and did not reproduce, which is why 1-run results are not usable here.

full_corpus_ab.noise_floor: Leaf descriptions were identical between arms, yet leaf recall moved by up to 0.244 (worktrees 0.556 -> 0.800) and -0.182 (debugging). At one run per query, a per-skill swing of about 0.2 is indistinguishable from noise, and root's 0.667 vs 0.500 sits inside it.
full_corpus_ab.reading: The root claimed a leaf-positive query zero times in either arm across 144 queries, so the premise for narrowing never appeared. The narrowing was reverted.

measured_outcome.evidence_gap: nm-zg (queries engineered as hard negatives for the root) has only 3 entries. If the root-over-breadth concern is ever raised again, expand that group rather than rewording the description.
measured_outcome.what_was_kept: Independent of breadth and left in place: the body now defers to the description instead of restating the preconditions; README and the design doc no longer restate the trigger surface or the eval run status; run-trigger-eval.mjs passes a permission mode (print mode otherwise blocks on a model that tries to write files).

changes_since_supersede.evidence: results/triggers-deepseek-full-broad.json — the shipped catalog, all 144 queries, 1 run each, host claude (reference adapter, stream-json), driving model deepseek-flash, split_sha256 c980836bdcc1. Only train-split failures guided the wording; validation failures in the same report were not consulted.
changes_since_supersede.caveat: One run per query. Leaf-description-identical arms in the root experiment swung by up to 0.244, so an individual single-run miss can be a flip. The wording changes below are aimed at mechanisms visible across several misses, not at any single case.

per_skill.observed_failure: 5 of 10 positives loaded nothing. Every hit (ver-pos-03/06/08/09/10) was framed as questioning an existing claim; every miss (01, 02, 04, 05, 07) was framed as wanting a check before acting — about to commit, push, hand off, or call it done.
per_skill.change: Dropped the 'without fresh evidence for it' qualifier, which reads as an unmet precondition rather than a situation the skill applies to, and named the pre-action moments directly.

per_skill.observed_failure: 5 of 10 positives loaded nothing (01, 03, 04, 08, 10). The queries say patch, 改动, 有没有坑, 审查报告, 独立评审, 公共接口; the trigger clause carried only review / 审查 / 过一遍.
per_skill.change: Added the phrasings users actually typed (patch, 改动, 公共接口, 坑, 安全问题, 审查报告, 独立评审) and restated the no-edit precondition as an option rather than a gate.

per_skill.observed_failure: 5 of 10 positives loaded nothing (02, 05, 06, 08, 10). Misses never say "review feedback arrived"; they say 同事说, 审查报告里有一条, 上一轮审查的结论, 哪条真的成立.
per_skill.change: Added the colleague / 审查报告 / 上一轮审查 / 哪条成立 phrasings while keeping the verify-not-accept discipline as the capability clause.

per_skill.observed_failure: wt-pos-05 (English, "isolated checkout") and wt-pos-09 ("把工作区隔离出来" before executing a plan) loaded nothing; wt-pos-08 was routed to zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents instead.
per_skill.change: Named the before-the-plan moment and the parallel-features case, so isolation requested as a precondition or as one of several parallel scopes is covered without relying on the literal word worktree.

changes_since_supersede.measurement: not re-measured after this edit; a re-run of these four skills' own positives is required before quoting any rate for it.

required_before_claiming_rates: run evals/triggers/catalog-queries.json through a real agent with the full catalog installed, scored on the skill the host actually loaded
the fixed train/validation split recorded in split_sha256 must not change in the same change as a description edit
only train failures may guide description edits; the shipped description is the one with the best validation pass rate, not the last one produced
report recall and precision per skill, plus the should-trigger-nothing clean rate for root false positives
publish the validation split of this catalog under the same host and driving model as the train run it was chosen against; the train rate alone is not a shipped rate
the legacy judge harness (evals/skill-triggering.json) is not sufficient evidence: it never runs an agent and never observes a skill load
unmeasurable_by_this_harness: The judge sees only name and description (routing_evaluation.system_prompt). SKILL.md body routing predicates cannot move any rate in this eval; they govern runtime behavior after a skill loads and need a separate acceptance run.

entries.name: zhanggui
entries.description: Owns one development request end-to-end — resolves open design decisions, plans the path, implements with tests, and carries the work to verified delivery. Use when a development request must be carried from an unclear idea or unresolved design decisions through implementation to verified delivery, when it spans multiple modules or produces multiple deliverables, when an interrupted task with a saved checkpoint is being resumed, or when someone hands over end-to-end ownership of a feature, migration, or redesign.

entries.name: zhanggui-systematic-debugging
entries.description: Traces a failure to its root cause with evidence before any fix is written, then guards the finding with a regression test. Use when a test failure, production bug, build failure, integration failure, performance problem, or otherwise unexpected behavior needs its root cause found, including when earlier fix attempts did not hold or the problem is still not understood, even when it looks like a flaky test, a config difference, or an environment problem.

entries.name: zhanggui-test-driven-development
entries.description: Drives implementation from a failing test — red first, then the minimum code to go green. Use when a new feature, bug fix, refactor, or behavior change is about to be implemented and the failing test or regression test must be written first, before any implementation code exists, even when the request only says to add or change a feature.

entries.name: zhanggui-verification-before-completion
entries.description: Proves a completion claim with fresh evidence — real command output, test results, an actual run — before anyone acts on that claim. Use when work is about to be called done, fixed, passing, or ready, when a commit, push, or handoff is about to rest on it, when someone wants the actual command output rather than a summary, when an earlier 已修复 or 通过 claim has to be re-checked, or when the change looks small and safe and still needs evidence instead of a feeling.

entries.name: zhanggui-requesting-code-review
entries.description: Runs a new independent review of a diff, patch, or set of changed files and reports Critical and Important findings by severity. Use when someone asks for a review, 审查, 过一遍, or 独立评审 of a diff, patch, 改动, or 公共接口, asks whether a change has 坑 or 安全问题, wants a written 审查报告 for a pull request, wants only reviewing with no edit to the code, or needs a one-line change, a three-file refactor, or a release script about to go live checked by someone else.

entries.name: zhanggui-receiving-code-review
entries.description: Verifies incoming review feedback item by item and gives each one an explicit disposition — accepted, rejected with evidence, or implemented. Use when review feedback, reviewer comments, or a 审查报告 has arrived and each 条 needs technical checking before it is accepted or pushed back, including when a 同事 claims the implementation is wrong, when a 上一轮审查 left 结论 still unresolved, and when someone wants to know 哪条真的成立 instead of accepting it performatively.

entries.name: zhanggui-using-git-worktrees
entries.description: Creates an isolated git worktree for feature work so the main working tree stays untouched, and tears one down again when the work is done. Use when feature work needs an isolated checkout, a write scope separated from the main working tree, or a dedicated workspace for executing an implementation plan, when parallel features each need their own checkout, when the workspace has to be isolated before a plan starts, and when an existing worktree has to be set up or cleaned up rather than left behind, even if the request never says 'worktree'.

entries.name: zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents
entries.description: Runs independent pieces of work at the same time instead of one after another, keeping one writer per file set. Use when subagent capacity is available and two or more independent problem domains can run at the same time on non-overlapping files without shared state, including when the parallel dispatch is already decided and only the non-overlapping file scope remains to be settled, and when the request only lists several things to do.

entries.name: zhanggui-finishing-a-development-branch
entries.description: Closes out branch or worktree work whose verification is already settled, turning it into one explicit landing decision — merge, open a pull request, keep the branch, or discard it. Use when the work is already verified and what remains is how it lands, such as merging, opening a pull request, keeping the branch, or discarding it, including right after the user says the tests passed, even if they never mention merging or a pull request.

measured_by.family: legacy judge harness - a description-confusion check, not a trigger measurement
measured_by.measured_against: the superseded trigger-only catalog, not this one

trigger_family.note: The host ships its own built-in skills (code-review, verify, debug, simplify, and others) that the catalog competes with; they cannot be disabled and they are not counted as catalog loads. Trigger rates are a property of the catalog plus this host plus this driving model, so a rate recorded under a different model is not comparable: the same corpus and the same catalog scored a train pass rate of 0.656 under deepseek-flash and 0.914 under qwen3.8-flash.

records.catalog: the superseded trigger-only-plus-capability catalog, before the revisions recorded above
records.note: Baseline for the description revisions recorded above. Only these failures were used to guide the edits.

records.kind: targeted re-check, not a split rate
records.reason: setup-collaboration-files was renamed, and the name is part of what the host sees. Only the 13 queries whose label names that skill were re-run; the other 131 were not, so this file must not be read as a train or validation pass rate.
records.note: The rename cost nothing: every successful run activated setup-collaboration-files, including ip-pos-07 (the phrase "init project"), and none were lost to a neighbouring skill. Re-run after nm-ip-02 was relabelled, so this file is the post-change evidence for both the rename and the label fix.

renames.note: This skill is outside the nine-entry catalog snapshot, so the rename does not move the digest. The records below were measured under the old name; the description text is unchanged, but the name is part of what the host sees, so its pre-rename rates must not be quoted as rates for the renamed skill. Corpus expected_skill values were updated; query ids and the train/validation split were not, so split_sha256 is unchanged.

trigger_family.version_selection: The two candidates tie on validation (48/51 both). The shipped catalog is not a validated improvement: it is shipped because the aggregate does not regress and because its one target fix is same-signed on both splits (zhanggui-requesting-code-review recall 0.556 -> 0.833 on train, 0.500 -> 0.750 on validation, mechanism visible in req-pos-08 where the host's built-in code-review skill used to win 2 of 3 runs and now wins none). Every other per-skill delta reverses sign between the two splits, which is run-to-run variance at 2-3 repetitions per query.

discarded_records.reason: 81 of 279 invocations exited 1 because the endpoint rate-limits to 11 requests per minute. Its 0.892 train pass rate describes a catalogue plus mandatory retry outages, not the catalogue, and must not be cited.

quality_family.agent_permissions: bypassPermissions (the default mode denies every Bash and Write, which collapses both arms into static analysis and makes the delta measure nothing)
quality_family.variance_warning: Two cases per skill with one run per arm. Deltas moved between configurations within this batch; these two numbers will not resolve whether a skill wins reliably, only whether it currently beats its own baseline.
